releases.name: v0.3.0 — session usage + low-balance toast
releases.body:
### Added
- **`tokenmix_usage` tool** — reports the current OpenCode session's token usage (input / output / total), tracked from `message.updated` events (latest value per message, so streaming replies aren't double-counted).
- **Low-balance toast** — after the assistant goes idle, the plugin checks your wallet (throttled to once a minute) and shows a one-time warning when available balance dips below a threshold (re-arms on recovery). Configure with `["@tokenmix/opencode-plugin", { "lowBalanceThreshold": 2 }]` (USD; default 1).

Every wallet/TUI call is wrapped, so a failure never disrupts your session.

Install / upgrade: list `"@tokenmix/opencode-plugin"` in your `opencode.json` `plugin` array (OpenCode auto-updates).

releases.name: v0.2.0 — live balance
releases.body: tokenmix_balance now calls `GET /v1/wallet` and returns the live balance, gift credit, and total spent. Requires backend to serve `/v1/wallet` (shipped together).

releases.name: v0.1.2 — canonical name on npm
releases.body:
Republished as the canonical scoped name **`@tokenmix/opencode-plugin`**.

Two interim unscoped names (`tokenmix-coding-plugin`, `tokenmix-opencode-plugin`) were created during npm diagnostics and are now deprecated. Install only the scoped name:

```json
{
  "plugin": ["@tokenmix/opencode-plugin"]
}
```

No functional changes vs 0.1.0 — same 3 tools (tokenmix_balance / tokenmix_topup / tokenmix_models).

releases.name: v0.1.0 — first public release
releases.body:
First public release on npm: [@tokenmix/opencode-plugin](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@tokenmix/opencode-plugin).

## Install

In your \`opencode.json\`:
\`\`\`json
{
  "plugin": ["@tokenmix/opencode-plugin"]
}
\`\`\`

## What the agent gets

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| \`tokenmix_models\` | Lists all tokenmix-served models with prices, optional \`type\` filter |
| \`tokenmix_topup\` | Opens \`tokenmix.ai/dashboard/credits\` in the browser |
| \`tokenmix_balance\` | Prints a dashboard link (live balance in v0.2) |

See [CHANGELOG.md](./CHANGELOG.md) for details and roadmap.
